Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/942)
Some years ago [Mr Craik](/person/379) wrote to me that the sale of the [Cameos of English History](/book/73) had so fallen off that it was not worth while to give me £100 for the copyright of the volume after it had appeared in the[ Monthly Packet](/periodical/52), and I therefore discontinued thinking of the separate publication. I think the volumes ended with the [Restoration](/book/213)
Since that, and especially lately, so many people have asked for the volumes to be continued that I venture to ask whether you would go on with them, giving me a smaller sum for the copyright

Yours truly

C M Yonge
